standard_login.details: Login with aaron@stech.com.au / Lucky@2871$! works correctly

get_notifications_api.details: GET /api/notifications returns notifications array with proper structure (id, type, message, severity, read, created_at)

generate_notifications_api.details: POST /api/notifications/generate creates notifications from system state (SLA breach, device offline, contract renewal, etc.)

mark_read_all_api.details: POST /api/notifications/mark-read without ids marks ALL notifications as read

mark_read_specific_api.details: POST /api/notifications/mark-read with ids array marks specific notifications as read

get_kanban_board_api.details: GET /api/kanban-tickets/board returns board with 5 columns (open, in_progress, waiting, resolved, closed)

move_ticket_api.details: PUT /api/kanban-tickets/move changes ticket status and persists to database

notifications_page_ui.details: Notifications page at /notifications renders with search, type filter, severity filter, read filter, Mark All Read button, Refresh button

notifications_grouped_by_date.details: Notifications are grouped by date (TODAY, Yesterday, etc.)

sidebar_bell_dropdown.details: Notification bell in sidebar opens dropdown with recent notifications and 'View All Notifications' link

view_all_navigation.details: View All Notifications link navigates to /notifications page

kanban_board_5_columns.details: Kanban board renders 5 columns: Open, In Progress, Waiting, Resolved, Closed

kanban_search_filter.details: Kanban search input filters tickets by title/ticket number/client name

kanban_priority_filter.details: Priority filter dropdown filters tickets by critical/high/medium/low

kanban_ticket_cards.details: Ticket cards display priority badges (critical, high, medium, low) and ticket numbers

kanban_drag_drop.details: HTML5 native drag-and-drop moves tickets between columns and updates status via API

mocked_apis.note: No mocked APIs - all notifications generated from real system state (devices, tickets, contracts, leads)
